svg.text: Automatic supply selection and protected U4
Distinct A5 / B5 rails • Retain four USB roles • Basis 0b431a9
Matching remote labels and rails join electrically. X is deliberate NC. See REVIEW.md for fit and power holds.
A is preferred. B fallback carries the module and qualified local loads only.
J2 default, ROM/reset and suspended fallback still require measured current.
U4 source selection and U2 admission
The B branch stays off without authorization. IC7 independently limits B current.
U4 may disconnect during cutover. Reattach only after qualified power and data state.
Reverse-blocked U4 output with local power-good
B: allow 200 mA settled only after qualification.
Qualify ramp, hot plug, forced J4 VBUS and latch-off recovery.
